articles.availability_note: This account reports Simon Stiell’s November 13, 2026 COP31 speech and earlier COP29 targets, collected November 16. USD300 billion annually by 2035, with developed countries taking the lead, is distinct from the broader all-source USD1.3 trillion annual mobilisation ambition. These targets are not added together or treated as funds already delivered. Affordable terms, simpler access and stronger country institutions are advocated changes; delivery and resilience effects require subsequent evidence.

articles.availability_note: Catch-up addition first published November 18, 2026 (Hong Kong time). Research and the university report are dated November 12, 2026; collected November 16. The study evaluates 53 named species, supports 47, and includes 12 removed from synonymy and four formerly unresolved species within that 47. Recognition refines an inventory rather than increasing reef populations. Historical reference specimens, matching modern material and genomic relationships supply converging evidence; geographic reference confidence varies. The institutional article and indexed publisher sections were inspected; full supplementary data and underlying sequences were not independently reanalysed.
